epics.title: Autonomous Sovereign Designer Engine
epics.jtbd: When the client requests a new product design, I want the system to autonomously synthesize, render, and visually audit a complete UI/UX mockup, so that high-end design assets are produced without relying on external paid design services.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual audit passing rate across design generations
requirements: R1: Implement missing DesignTokenCompiler and LayoutPatternRegistry specification requirements, enforcing explicit auth/validation error states (400, 401, 403).
R2: Remove faked PR review stubs (hallucinated .gitignore and PR #0 verdicts) and enforce FILE CHANNEL INVARIANT by preventing factory record files (.eneik/records) in product PRs.

slices.title: Patch Designer Engine specification and CI hygiene
slices.jtbd: When implementing this defect batch for this epic, I want to patch the core missing specification requirements and enforce CI review integrity, so that the Autonomous Sovereign Designer Engine outcome is achieved safely and reliably.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a request to the DesignTokenCompiler, When it lacks auth or fails data validation, Then it returns 400, 401, or 403 error states.
Given a PR review, When it runs, Then it executes real validation logic without faked stubs and rejects any leaked .eneik/records files.
Given the complete defect batch, When tested, Then unit, integration, and E2E QA tests verify the implemented LayoutPatternRegistry and auth logic.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Percentage of invalid requests correctly returning 400/401/403 status codes
